report.summary: Patient P-D002 (46F, Medicaid with transport benefit, tract 17031300900) screened positive today for utilities shutoff risk and transportation need. Two prior endocrinology visits were missed/cancelled, consistent with a transport barrier; today's primary-care visit was kept. Utility options: income-based bill assistance (Neighborhood Energy Help, apply in person Mon/Wed) and a walk-in Shutoff Prevention Clinic (Tuesdays) for disconnection notices. Transport options: Medicaid Ride Line is eligible (call the number on the Medicaid card at least 2 business days ahead); Senior Shuttle West is ineligible (age 60+); ADA paratransit is possible but certification takes up to 21 days and disability status is unconfirmed. A transit feasibility check for today's appointment could not be run because no facility location is on file for appt:3.
